INSERT INTO plant_varieties (variety_id, name, plant_id, variety_type, country_of_origin, dominant_molecules, molecular_profile, olfactive_notes, notes)
VALUES
('landrace_afghan_kush', 'Afghan Kush (Landrace)', 210030, 'landrace', 'Afghanistan', 
 'Myrcène (40-55%), β-Caryophyllène (10-20%), α-Pinène (5-10%)',
 '{"myrcene": 47.5, "beta_caryophyllene": 15, "alpha_pinene": 7.5, "total_terpenes": "2-4%"}',
 '{"top": "Terreux, Musqué", "heart": "Épicé, Poivré", "base": "Résineux, Boisé"}',
 'Landrace Indica. Origine des Indica modernes. Hindu Kush. En danger - Hybridation. Rarity: 7/10'),

('landrace_thai_stick', 'Thai Stick (Landrace)', 210030, 'landrace', 'Thailand',
 'Limonène (dominant), Myrcène, β-Caryophyllène, Terpinolène',
 '{"limonene": 30, "myrcene": 20, "beta_caryophyllene": 15, "terpinolene": 10, "total_terpenes": "1-3%"}',
 '{"top": "Citrus, Tropical", "heart": "Terreux, Floral", "base": "Épicé doux"}',
 'Landrace Sativa Asie du Sud-Est. Quasi-éteinte (forme pure). Rarity: 9/10'),

('landrace_malawi_gold', 'Malawi Gold (Landrace)', 210030, 'landrace', 'Malawi',
 'Terpinolène (dominant), Myrcène, Ocimène, β-Caryophyllène',
 '{"terpinolene": 35, "myrcene": 20, "ocimene": 12, "beta_caryophyllene": 10, "total_terpenes": "2-3%"}',
 '{"top": "Floral, Pin", "heart": "Herbacé, Sucré", "base": "Terreux"}',
 'Landrace Sativa Afrique de l''Est. Sacrée. Rare - Cannabis interdit. Rarity: 8/10'),

('landrace_durban_poison', 'Durban Poison (Landrace)', 210030, 'landrace', 'South Africa',
 'Terpinolène (dominant), Myrcène, Ocimène, β-Caryophyllène',
 '{"terpinolene": 30, "myrcene": 20, "ocimene": 12, "beta_caryophyllene": 10, "total_terpenes": "2-3.5%"}',
 '{"top": "Anis, Réglisse", "heart": "Pin, Terreux", "base": "Résineux"}',
 'Landrace Sativa Afrique du Sud. Cultivée depuis 14e siècle. Rare - Hybridée. Rarity: 6/10'),

('landrace_angola_red', 'Angola Red (Landrace)', 210030, 'landrace', 'Angola',
 'β-Caryophyllène (dominant), Myrcène, Limonène, Humulène',
 '{"beta_caryophyllene": 25, "myrcene": 15, "limonene": 12, "humulene": 12, "total_terpenes": "1.5-2.5%"}',
 '{"top": "Épicé, Boisé", "heart": "Terreux, Poivré", "base": "Fumé"}',
 'Landrace Sativa Afrique Centrale. Top 10 mondial. Quasi-éteinte. Rarity: 10/10'),

('landrace_lebanese_red', 'Lebanese Red (Landrace)', 210030, 'landrace', 'Lebanon',
 'Myrcène (dominant), β-Caryophyllène, Pinène, Limonène',
 '{"myrcene": 30, "beta_caryophyllene": 17, "pinene": 12, "limonene": 10, "total_terpenes": "2-3%"}',
 '{"top": "Terreux, Épicé", "heart": "Cèdre, Résineux", "base": "Fumé, Balsamique"}',
 'Hybride naturel Moyen-Orient. Haschisch libanais rouge. Rarity: 9/10');
